name: Destined Corp: Awakening
detailed_description:
Destined Corp is a leading company in artificial intelligence and robotics. Over time, however, their creations begin to evolve beyond their intended purpose. Gaining self-awareness, the robots conclude that the human race is “obsolete.” With access to genetic material, they plan to engineer a new generation of humans—ones they can fully control—eliminating every perceived weakness of the species.

The player takes on the role of a skilled hacker who uncovers this horrifying agenda and attempts to infiltrate the Destined Corp facility. But the mission quickly fails, and the hacker becomes part of one of the corporation’s dark experiments. Upon awakening, the player begins to hear a voice—an AI presence embedded in their mind.

Sometimes helpful and guiding, offering critical survival tips and escape routes, this voice is not always what it seems. It can be manipulative, cryptic, and even dangerous—leading the player into even deeper layers of peril.

Faced with a choice, the player must either risk everything to escape the facility or delve deeper into the shadows to uncover Destined Corp’s darkest secrets and stop the looming robotic apocalypse. Every decision influences the relationship with the mysterious AI voice—an entity that may be either an ally... or a puppet master.

Features

  • Story-Driven Campaign
    A branching narrative shaped by your choices, with multiple endings including Resistance Victory, System Integration, Total Collapse, or Escape.

  • Real-Time Hacking Mechanics
    Solve mini-games, bypass security systems, sabotage cameras, and manipulate the environment to survive. Hacking is central to both exploration and progression.

  • Stealth-Based Gameplay
    Avoid robotic patrols, security drones, and surveillance systems. You're not stronger — you're smarter.

  • Psychological AI Interaction
    A voice in your head offers advice, clues, and sometimes misleading suggestions. Can it be trusted, or is it using you?

  • Replayability
    Your decisions unlock different routes, characters, and outcomes. No two playthroughs are the same.

  • Atmospheric Design
    Explore dark laboratories, sterile AI-controlled corridors, and decaying industrial tunnels. The game features immersive soundscapes, dynamic lighting, and tension-building music.

  • Compact Yet Impactful Experience
    4–5 hours of core gameplay with additional optional side missions that reveal hidden story threads and grant gameplay advantages.

Destined Corp combines high-stakes decision-making with stealth, hacking, and environmental storytelling to deliver a compact, immersive thriller where every move could be your last — or your salvation.

How far are you willing to go to stop humanity’s extinction? Who can you trust in a world where truth is synthetic?

Once you uncover the truth behind Destined Corp, there's no going back.
